correctness.rationale: Over F_(q^2), lambda nonzero forces the discriminant to be a square; a trace-zero field basis reduces the equation exactly to (1-lambda)a^2+D(1+lambda)b^2-2Dd^2=0, a nondegenerate ternary quadratic with q^2 zeros. The t=0 fiber is counted singly; the others doubly, yielding (q^3+q+2)/2 including infinity. Full finite enumerations for p=5,7,11 agree. Orbit conclusion follows from prior exact short-orbit classification.

value.rationale: Resolves rationality of one of two geometrically equal-size tame PGL2 orbits for a natural smooth pencil over every odd finite field, exactly counts degree-two closed points, and quantifies a sharp Hermitian-specialization jump. This arithmetic distinction is not supplied by the geometric orbit sizes and is motivated by finite-field forms of large-automorphism curves.
